title: Match Number and Group
short: Find the group that goes with a number.

blocks.html: Can you find the group that goes with a number? Look at the number, then count each group. Which one matches?
Count each group. The one that has the same count as the number is the match.

For the grown-up: Lay out a number card and three piles of different sizes. Let your child find the match. Then switch: your child makes a pile and you write the number. Keep screen time short: two or three problems, then play.

items: Try it at home: Play “number hunt” with cards and toys.
Make a pile for a number your child picks.
Build towers to match number cards.
